agentStation.socketPath.description: Override the daemon socket path. Empty uses the default location.

agentStation.suppressProviderNotificatio.description: Turn off other agent extensions' own OS notifications so Agent Station is the single attention surface. Always shows a diff before writing, and is fully reversible.

agentStation.bindIntegratedTerminalSessi.description: Bind CLI agent sessions running in the integrated terminal to this window, so Jump-to-session lands in the right place.
